title: Broccoli and Basil Pesto Linguine
changes_from_base: A green pesto bulked out with steamed broccoli replaces the tomato sauce; fresh tomato slices are served on the side.
summary: Linguine in a creamy, bright green pesto made by blending steamed broccoli with basil, pine nuts, garlic and Parmesan.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 3 litres of pasta water (0.5%)
ingredients.note: about 2.5 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

steps.title: Steam the broccoli
steps.text: Cut it into florets and steam about 5 min until tender but still bright green. Save 6 tbsp of the steaming water.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Whizz the garlic in the processor, then add the basil, pine nuts and oil and blend until minced. Add the warm broccoli and blend until smooth, loosening with the steaming water a spoonful at a time. Blend in the Parmesan and pepper. Broccoli stretches the pesto into a thick, creamy sauce with far less oil than usual.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the linguine in 3 litres salted water until al dente and drain.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Toss the hot pasta with the pesto and serve with the sliced tomatoes on the side.

tips: Steam the broccoli only until tender so the pesto stays bright.
Toast the pine nuts first for a deeper flavour.
The pesto also works spread on toast or stirred into soup.
storage: Cool and refrigerate in an airtight container within 2 hours for up to 2 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C).
